text:
maya: Nightly eval failed for rwi-2-q on the tool-calling tests. Lots of JSON parse errors in the harness. Anyone seen this? @alex

alex: Ugh. Which prompt set? job id?

maya: Job: nightly-eval/2026-03-17-rwi-2-q (https://ci.internal/nightly/1754829000) Prompt set: \"api-tooling/structured-output\". A bunch of examples failed schema validation. Eval log snippet below.

eval-bot: ERROR eval-harness: JSONDecodeError at example 124: Expecting property name enclosed in "double quotes": line 1 column 2 (char 1)

cheng: Put sample output I grabbed from the failing run:

```json
{'tool': 'extract_entities', 'args': "{'text': \"Acme shipped 200 units.\", 'top_k': 5}", result: "entities: [Acme, 200]"}
```

cheng: That's single quotes and args is stringified dict. Also `result` isn't a JSON object. This will blow up json.loads.

sam: That's the quant build we rolled yesterday, right? rwi-2-q:v3-quant. Could be the tool-caller decoding path returning `str()` of python dict instead of json.dumps.

maya: Reproducer: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/test/toolcall \
  -d '{"model":"rwi-2-q:v3-quant","prompt":"Extract entities: Acme shipped 200 units."}'
```

Response:

```text
{'tool': 'extract_entities', 'args': "{'text': 'Acme shipped 200 units.', 'top_k': 5}", result: "entities: [Acme, 200]"}
```

alex: Can we confirm if this happens only on quantized variant? Any differences for float32?

cheng: Running same prompt against rwi-2-ptx (non-quant) gave:

```json
{"tool":"extract_entities","args":{"text":"Acme shipped 200 units.","top_k":5},"result":{"entities":["Acme","200"]}}
```

cheng: So yes, appears quant variant returns python-literal output. Likely postprocess wrapper invoking `repr()` in some code path.

sam: Quick mitigation: add a schema validation that attempts ast.literal_eval for single-quoted strings and then re-serialize to proper JSON before feeding eval harness. But that's hacky.

maya: Plan: 1) Block the v3-quant rollout to nightly (disable from deployer) 2) Add a repro test in CI 3) Fix wrapper that handles tool-call outputs in runtime. @cheng can you own the fix? :pray: 

cheng: I'll take it. I'll add a sanity check at runtime: if output looks like python-literal use ast.literal_eval then json.dumps. Also add unit tests. Will open PR this afternoon.

alex: Also add metric to track % of tool-call outputs failing strict JSON per model variant so we catch drift.

maya: Thanks. I'll add the incident card and notify ops. :eyes:

eval-bot: automated-note: job nightly-eval/2026-03-17-rwi-2-q marked failed -> incident created (#INC-2026-0423)
